meta.notes: Facebook serves iPhone user agents the Bloks layout on m.facebook.com (www redirects there); desktop selectors (aria-posinset, role=feed, hashed x* classes) match nothing, and the generic wbloks_* and m classes sit on almost every element. LIVE (logged out): get-app-bar matched the 42 px banner on the login page, open-app-button matched the sticky button on public pages, full-experience-sheet matched the one dialog on /watch/ and /reel/ (its aria-label starts "Get the full experience"; hiding every aria-modal dialog would also hide logged-in comment and share sheets), reels-profile-tab matched on a page's tab strip, reels-chip matched the "Reels , 2 of 5" chip, reels-thumbnails matched the "View reel video from ..." buttons. On /reel/ the whole page is the wall, so hiding the sheet is cosmetic. unlock-scroll is scoped to pages that hold the sheet because Bloks may rely on body overflow elsewhere. SOURCE only, not seen live (logged-in): stories-row (kurtnettle/uBO-filters-fb). Labels are English only. No CSS selector was found for suggested or sponsored posts on Bloks, so there is no option for them.
